subject: Palantir Technologies Inc. Q2 2026 disclosure context

sources.claim: Palantir's investor-relations calendar identifies Q2 2026 earnings on 2026-08-03 and links the earnings release and presentation.
The issuer release reports 93% year-over-year revenue growth, 149% U.S. commercial revenue growth, and higher full-year guidance.
The Q1 2026 10-Q reports $1.633 billion quarterly revenue, 85% year-over-year growth, 87% gross margin, no outstanding debt, and an undrawn $500 million revolver.
The 2025 annual report reports 56% revenue growth, 82% gross margin, and $7.2 billion of cash, cash equivalents, and short-term Treasury securities.
